coverage_issues: Report 1 failed to audit one of the LICENSE files due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400), leading to an overall inconclusive verdict.
learnings: The audit tool should implement retry logic or graceful degradation for transient LLM API errors (like HTTP 400/500) on non-executable files (e.g., LICENSE, README). Failing the entire package audit as 'inconclusive' due to an API error on a static text file is overly brittle.
